label: setup
sql: CREATE TABLE DocDiffNodes (Id INT64 NOT NULL, Value INT64, Other INT64, J JSON) PRIMARY KEY(Id)
CREATE TABLE DocDiffEdges (Src INT64 NOT NULL, Dst INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY(Src,Dst)

CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH DocDiffGraph NODE TABLES (DocDiffNodes KEY(Id) LABEL Node PROPERTIES(Id,Value)) EDGE TABLES (DocDiffEdges KEY(Src,Dst) SOURCE KEY(Src) REFERENCES DocDiffNodes(Id) DESTINATION KEY(Dst) REFERENCES DocDiffNodes(Id) LABEL Edge PROPERTIES(Src,Dst))
CREATE CHANGE STREAM DocDiffStream FOR DocDiffNodes(Value)
